reason: A successful main turn continues durable now/next input in one engine-owned admission. Held completion cannot end a continued turn; stopped or failed turns never restart themselves. Explicit stop publishes any held real completion without starting title inference, so a refused stop/close cannot leave a finished turn busy. Passive child results carry triggerTurn=false and remain queued without admitting another main turn; older background-task receipts retain that same meaning.
stoppedCompletionNote: queuePaused was removed from this vector on purpose. The host used to stamp that flag onto the done frame so the RENDERER could pause its own in-memory follow-up queue. The queue moved into the host (main/sessions/client-queue.ts), where afterTurnTerminal reads this same terminal event and pauses the queue itself, so no renderer-facing hint is produced any more. Keeping the field would pin a contract that nothing emits. The vector is now a stronger invariant: the published completion is exactly these fields, so a future change cannot smuggle an invented field back onto it.

pending.name: child input belongs to its child
reserved input already has an owner
passive child result cannot reopen a completed parent
explicit followup admits a new turn
